body:
Road conditions

  • 1-800-459-ROAD or 511-Road Conditions
  • Construction report/road conditions map: https://kytc.maps.arcgis.com/apps/webappviewer/index.html?id=327a38decc8c4e5cb882dc6cd0f9d45d

When Permit Is Needed

  • Over 8' wide
  • Over 13'6" high
  • Trailer over 53' long
  • Over 80,000 lbs.

Special Information Needed

  • Company's KYU number
  • Manufacturer & model of load; overhang( if any)
  • Dozer over 12 wide-Does it have a bucket or a blade?

Times Of Movement

  • 1/2 hour before sunrise to 1/2 hour after sunset. Weekend travel allowed except superloads.
  • No longer a "holiday" restriction unless it is a Superload or a House move; Travel is allowed 24-7 unless specified otherwise on permit.
  • Curfews: No OW/OD loads permitted to travel in the following counties: Boone, Kenton, Campbell, Fayette, Jefferson from 7-9am or 4-6pm M-F;
  • (applies to Owensboro, KY 431 bridge, as well)

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

  • https://drive.ky.gov/motor-carriers/pages/owod-Escort-Requirements.aspx
  • On 2- lane highways:
  • Width over 12' -1 front & 1 rear
  • Width over 16’-2 front/2 rear
  • 75' to 85' long-1 front
  • Over 85' long- 1 front & 1 rear
  • Over 120’ long-1 front/2 rear
  • 4 or more lane divided highways:
  • Over 12' wide-1 rear
  • Over 14’ wide-1 front/1 rear
  • Over 16’ wide-2 front/2 rear
  • Speed at least 45 MPH-1 rear
  • Length 110’-1 rear
  • Over 120' long-2 rear/1 front
  • Height over 14’ 11”-1 front escort w/ height pole
  • Overhang over 10'-1 (@ point of overhang)

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • Signs: Post appropriate signs on vehicle. Warning sign shall be 6’-8’ wide. “OVERSIZE LOAD” in black letters ( at least 18” high; brush stroke at least 1.4”) on yellow background.
  • Lights: Amber strobe lights or flashing light on top
  • Flags: No stipulations
  • Additional equipment: 2-way radio; height pole if load is 15” or greater
  • Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator N/A
  • Dept. of Transportation Permits Office Hours: Walk-in-8am-3:30pm; Phone calls 8am-4:30pm M-Th

Division of Motor Carriers

OW/OD Section

  • Frankfort, KY 40602
  • (502)564-1257; fax-(502)564-0992
  • 200 Metro St. (Walk-ins & overnight delivery)
  • Frankfort, KY 40622
